prompt: Claude keeps answering with bullet lists and markdown. According to the prompting guide, which instruction steers it best?

options.text: "Do not use markdown in your response."
"NEVER, under any circumstances, use bullet points."
"Your response should be composed of smoothly flowing prose paragraphs."
"Try to avoid formatting if you can."

explanation: The guide advises telling Claude what to do instead of what not to do. Describing the desired output (flowing prose paragraphs) works better than a prohibition, and matching your own prompt style to the target style also helps.
